 Xiaomi 18 Pro Series brings dual 200MP cameras and a rear display
 A new way to interact
 Published
 on
 November 18, 2026 
 By
 Rodneil Quiteles 
 Xiaomi has unveiled the Xiaomi 18 Pro Series globally, introducing two new flagship smartphones with an unusual addition: a display on the back.
 The Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max headline the lineup with an AI-enhanced Back Display, a Leica Dual-200MP Camera System, and Qualcomm’s latest Snapdragon 8 Elite mobile platforms. Both phones also introduce Xiaomi Privacy Display technology and new AI-powered features.
 The Back Display is the biggest talking point. Built around a custom M11 panel, it offers up to 4,000 nits of peak brightness and a 1-120Hz LTPO refresh rate. It also sits beneath the same sheet of glass as the rear cameras, giving the back of the phone a more seamless appearance.
 The rear display does more than show notifications
 Xiaomi designed the Back Display to expand what users can do with the rear cameras.
 It doubles as a viewfinder for selfies, group photos, and vlogs. When the camera detects more than three people in a group selfie, it automatically switches to an ultra-wide perspective. Users can also record 8K video at up to 30fps with a real-time preview.
 Beyond photography, the smaller display can show notifications for calls, maps, ride-hailing services, and food deliveries. Users can pin text and images, including boarding passes and QR codes, for quick reference.
 AI brings even more functionality. AI Interpreter supports face-to-face translations in 29 languages, displaying each speaker’s language on their respective side of the phone.
 GenAI Apps also introduces vibe coding to smartphones. Users can describe an idea in natural language to create mini apps, with more than 50 preset apps available as starting points. AI Group Photo Wallpapers can also generate composite portraits featuring pets, celebrities, or fictional characters.
 Leica brings two 200MP cameras
 Photography remains central to the Xiaomi 18 Pro Series.
 Both models feature a Leica Dual-200MP Camera System with a 200-megapixel main camera and a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto camera. The main sensor measures 1/1.28 inches, while the telephoto sensor measures 1/1.56 inches.
 The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max takes things further with its Light Fusion 960L main sensor, offering up to 16.2EV of dynamic range. Its periscope telephoto camera supports 75mm portraits and up to 150mm optical-level zoom. It also offers 12cm telemacro photography.
 The camera experience extends beyond hardware. Essential Moment introduces three photography styles: B&W Film, Iconic CCD, and Modern Vintage. Users can also recreate the optical characteristics of 35mm Documentary and 75mm Portrait lenses.
 For video, both smartphones support 4K recording at up to 120fps in Dolby Vision, 10-bit Log, and 8K recording at 30fps.
 Snapdragon power meets built-in privacy
 The Xiaomi 18 Pro Series runs on Qualcomm’s latest 2nm Snapdragon platforms.
 The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max uses the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, while the Xiaomi 18 Pro gets the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6. Both feature Qualcomm Oryon CPUs with two prime cores and six performance cores. Their prime cores can reach clock speeds of up to 5GHz.
 Xiaomi also introduces its Privacy Display technology, which limits visibility from side angles through dedicated privacy pixels. Privacy Mode can be applied to selected apps, notifications, floating windows, and split-screen views.
 Privacy Notice can detect nearby onlookers and alert users through discreet vibrations or Xiaomi HyperIsland. A customizable AI Button also provides quick access to Privacy Mode.
 The two phones differ in size and battery capacity. The Xiaomi 18 Pro features a 6.4-inch display and a 6,000mAh battery. The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max has a larger 6.9-inch display and a 7,050mAh battery.
 Both support 50W wireless HyperCharge. Wired charging reaches 90W on the Pro and 100W on the Pro Max.
 Xiaomi 18 Pro Series price and availability
 The Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max come in Black, White, Cosmic Blue, and Velvet Red.
 The Xiaomi 18 Pro starts at €1,399 , while the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max starts at €1,599 .
 Xiaomi also lists several storage configurations, with the Pro Max offering up to 16GB RAM and 1TB storage.
 Eligible purchases come with promotional benefits, including three months of Google AI Pro, three months of YouTube Premium, four months of Spotify Premium, and a seven- or 14-day iQIYI Standard VIP trial, depending on the offer.

 Xiaomi expands its smart home lineup with four new appliances
 Smarter everyday home living
 Published
 on
 November 18, 2026 
 By
 Rodneil Quiteles 
 Xiaomi is bringing four new smart home appliances to the global market, expanding its Mijia lineup with products designed to simplify laundry, food storage, and home cleaning.
 The new products include the Mijia Tri-Drum Washer Dryer Pro 12kg, Mijia Refrigerator Pro Multi-Door 546L, Xiaomi Robot Vacuum 6 Max, and Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 Max.
 All four products integrate smart features and connectivity through the Xiaomi Home app, allowing users to manage compatible appliances and automate everyday household routines.
 Mijia Tri-Drum Washer Dryer Pro handles three loads
 Mijia Tri-Drum Washer Dryer Pro 12kg. Three drums, one machine.
 Rated EU energy class A for the washing cycle, 40% less energy than class A requires.
Xiaomi Oxygen Care Technology breaks down stubborn stains and bacteria.
 Smart drying technology stops automatically when dry. https://t.co/8EoQqVWTke
 — Xiaomi (@Xiaomi) November 17, 2026 
 The Mijia Tri-Drum Washer Dryer Pro 12kg is Xiaomi’s first triple-drum washer dryer for overseas markets.
 It combines three independently operated drums in one appliance. This allows users to wash and dry adult clothing, children’s clothes, and different fabric types separately.
 Xiaomi says simultaneously washing loads across all three drums uses 48% less water and 49% less energy. It also takes 68% less time compared to completing three separate wash cycles using the Mijia Front Load Washer Dryer Pro 10kg.
 Its Oxygen Care Technology tackles 20 common tough stains, brightens white fabrics, and helps prevent color transfer. The washer also offers a 32-minute Smart Wash program and a 12-minute Quick Wash option across all three drums.
 Dedicated hygiene programs combine high-temperature steam and hot-water washing. Smart Drying automatically adjusts temperature and drying time to help prevent overdrying.
 Through the Xiaomi Home app, users can remotely manage wash programs and monitor water and electricity consumption.
 Mijia Refrigerator Pro adds smart ice-making
 Mijia Refrigerator Pro Multi-Door 546L.
 Even with 546 liters inside, it sits flush with your kitchen cabinets.
Cross-Door or French-Door freezer, the choice is yours.
 Mijia Smart Ice-maker System keeps ice ready, so you won’t run out. https://t.co/b3C9zFAvgB
 — Xiaomi (@Xiaomi) November 17, 2026 
 The Mijia Refrigerator Pro Multi-Door 546L combines generous storage capacity with automatic ice-making.
 Its ice-making system can store up to 180 ice cubes in the French-door configuration and 140 in the Cross-door version. A fast ice-making mode can also produce ice in as little as 55 minutes under Xiaomi’s stated test conditions.
 Users can manage ice-making schedules through the Xiaomi Home app. The refrigerator also sends alerts when its ice bin is full or water levels are low.
 For food preservation, Ion Hygiene+ helps reduce odors, while the Dual Cooling Fresh System allows independent temperature control for the refrigerator and freezer.
 Dual Humidity Boxes help fruits and vegetables retain moisture. Users can also log food by compartment and receive reminders about recommended storage times and expiration dates.
 The refrigerator comes in a Graphite Gray finish with premium glass door panels. Its 600mm body is designed to fit flush with kitchen cabinetry.
 Xiaomi Robot Vacuum 6 Max cleans difficult spaces
 Xiaomi Robot Vacuum 6 Max.
 Triple-Extension Edge Cleaning for tight corners, and a self-cleaning roller for mopping.
Just 9cm tall, it climbs door thresholds up to 6cm high.
 All with 35,000Pa of suction. https://t.co/160nYhqOTf
 — Xiaomi (@Xiaomi) November 17, 2026 
 The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum 6 Max focuses on reaching corners, furniture edges, and spaces beneath low furniture.
 Its triple mechanical arm system combines an extendable side brush, roller, and corner-cleaning mop pad. Xiaomi says this setup delivers up to 95% whole-home edge and corner coverage.
 Two bionic dual mechanical legs allow the robot to cross single-step thresholds up to 6cm. Its 9cm body and retractable radar also help it clean beneath furniture with at least 9.3cm of clearance.
 The robot delivers up to 35,000Pa of suction power. Its AI triple-camera obstacle avoidance system recognizes 200 types of common obstacles and 80 types of furniture. Another AI algorithm identifies 47 types of stains to help determine its cleaning strategy.
 Its self-cleaning omni station washes the roller and mop pad with hot water before drying them with hot air. The station also collects dust in a sealed 2.5L bag that can last up to 75 days under tested household conditions.
 Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 Max delivers powerful suction
 Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 Max.
 Engineered for deep cleaning.
A blue light to see the dust, 7 brushes and tools to reach it, 280AW of suction to pick it up.
 Even the emptying is done for you, so your hands stay clean. https://t.co/2NqisCyhrd
 — Xiaomi (@Xiaomi) November 17, 2026 
 For users who prefer a traditional cordless vacuum, the Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 Max offers up to 280AW of suction power in Turbo mode.
 Its 180-degree wide-angle blue light dust detection system makes fine dust easier to spot, with up to 30x magnification.
 The vacuum comes with seven brush heads and specialist cleaning tools for floors, upholstery, tight spaces, and pet hair. A bendable tube also makes it easier to clean beneath furniture.
 Its removable battery provides up to 90 minutes of runtime in Eco mode when using the 2-in-1 crevice brush.
 The included 4-in-1 Push-in Smart Dust Emptying Base Station combines automatic dust emptying, accessory storage, charging, and smart connectivity. It can empty the vacuum’s dust compartment in approximately 11 seconds, while its 3L disposable dust bag supports up to 100 days of use under tested household conditions.
 Xiaomi smart home appliances price and availability
 The four new appliances are now available through Xiaomi’s official channels and authorized retailers.
 Here are their starting prices:
 Mijia Tri-Drum Washer Dryer Pro 12kg: €1,499
 Mijia Refrigerator Pro Multi-Door 546L: €1,299
 Xiaomi Robot Vacuum 6 Max: €999.99
 Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 Max: €559.99

 Xiaomi launches Watch S5, Smart Band 11, and Clip earbuds
 New wearable lineup
 Published
 on
 November 18, 2026 
 By
 Rodneil Quiteles 
 Xiaomi has expanded its wearable lineup with three new products: Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm, Xiaomi Smart Band 11, and Xiaomi Clip.
 The new devices bring together smartwatch functionality, fitness tracking, and open-ear audio. The Watch S5 and Smart Band 11 also introduce Xiaomi HyperOS 4, offering refreshed interfaces and improved access to everyday information.
 The Xiaomi Clip is particularly interesting. It marks the company’s first entry into clip-on open-ear earbuds, offering a different approach to everyday listening.
 Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm brings smartwatch convenience
 That’s the new #XiaomiWatchS5 41mm.
A compact, refined design with a stainless steel frame and flexible lugs, all-new health and fitness insights, up to 14 days of battery life, and easy payments with Xiaomi Pay and Google Pay. https://t.co/6XPgjIsZ4Y
 — Xiaomi (@Xiaomi) November 17, 2026 
The Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm combines traditional watch styling with modern smartwatch features.
 Its compact stainless steel body features articulated lugs designed to follow the contours of the wrist. The Black and Light Blue versions feature stainless steel bezels and fluororubber straps, while Ceramic White gets a ceramic bezel and genuine leather strap.
 It has a 1.32-inch AMOLED display with up to 3,000 nits of peak brightness. Its 590mAh battery offers up to 14 days of use on a single charge.
 The Watch S5 41mm also brings Google Wallet to Xiaomi’s Watch S Series for the first time. Users can make contactless payments using supported bank cards and NFC. Xiaomi Pay is also supported in compatible markets.
 For fitness, the smartwatch offers more than 150 sports modes. Workout Picks recommends activities based on factors such as weather, physical condition, and exercise habits. Health Summary analyzes more than 50 fitness, sleep, and health metrics.
 Sleep Algorithm 2.0 improves sleep onset and wake-time accuracy by 11%, while sleep-stage accuracy improves by 14%, according to Xiaomi.
 Xiaomi Smart Band 11 adds more customization
 #XiaomiSmartBand11, Xiaomi’s most stylish smart band.
Slim and light in a range of colors and styles, now with a high-precision heart rate sensor and sleep HRV monitoring.
And even at just 15.58 grams, it lasts up to 21 days. https://t.co/qlNcAhWSvC
 — Xiaomi (@Xiaomi) November 17, 2026 
The Xiaomi Smart Band 11 focuses on personalization and everyday fitness tracking.
 Its 1.72-inch AMOLED display reaches up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness. The standard version features an aluminum frame in Midnight Black, Glacier Silver, Mystic Rose, and Moon Gold.
 NFC variants add more premium options, including pearl-white ceramic and a lavender-purple full-metal Unibody edition.
 Battery life reaches up to 21 days for the standard model and 18 days for NFC variants in light mode.
 The fitness tracker supports more than 150 sports modes and automatically recognizes six activities. Its upgraded heart rate sensor offers up to 98.2% comprehensive heart rate accuracy.
 Sleep Algorithm 2.0, Sleep HRV monitoring, and Vitality Score provide additional insights into daily activity and recovery. The band also supports 5ATM water resistance and underwater heart rate monitoring.
 Xiaomi HyperOS 4 brings a refreshed interface. The band can also connect simultaneously to compatible Xiaomi smartphones and iPhones, bringing notifications from both devices to the wrist.
 Xiaomi Clip introduces open-ear audio
 #XiaomiClip, Xiaomi’s first clip-on open-ear earbuds.
Light, comfortable, secure fit, powerful sound, and clear calls. IP57 dust and water resistant, and even at just 5.5 grams each they last up to 9 hours, or up to 38 hours with the charging case. https://t.co/KHK9Pev8EJ
 — Xiaomi (@Xiaomi) November 17, 2026 
 Xiaomi Clip is the brand’s first clip-on open-ear earbuds.
 Each earbud weighs just 5.5 grams and uses a flexible shape-memory alloy bridge that adapts to different ear shapes. Its open-ear design leaves the ear canal uncovered, allowing users to remain aware of their surroundings while listening.
 The earbuds feature an 11mm dynamic driver with a microcrystalline metal-coated diaphragm. They also support Hi-Res Audio Wireless and LHDC 5.0 on compatible devices.
 For calls, a four-microphone system combines three microphones and a VPU bone-conduction microphone. AI-powered noise reduction helps distinguish the user’s voice from surrounding sounds.
 Xiaomi Clip offers up to nine hours of playback on a single charge and up to 38 hours with its charging case. Other features include smart wear detection, audio sharing, customizable gestures, and Apple Find My support for locating the charging case.
 The earbuds come in Sand Gold, Pearl White, Graphite Black, and Frost Purple.
 Xiaomi wearables price and availability
 All three products are now available through Xiaomi’s official channels and authorized retailers.
 Here are their starting prices:
 Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm: €229.90
 Xiaomi Smart Band 11: €59.90
 Xiaomi Clip: €149.90

 2026’s The Game Awards will stream live on Disney+
 Published
 on
 November 13, 2026 
 By
 Luigi Leonardo 
 Annually, The Game Awards have become a sort of second Christmas for gamers. Besides a celebration of the past year in the world of videogames, the event hosts trailers for games of the upcoming year and beyond. Though it’s already free on several platforms, viewers can now tune in to Disney+ to watch this year’s Game Awards.
 Hosted as always by Geoff Keighley, 2026’s The Game Awards will happen on December 10 at 7:30pm ET. Most of the event will award the best titles of various categories for the year. Several publishers and developers also use the event to announce their upcoming titles. It’s for these reasons that a lot of gamers catch the event every year.
 This year, The Game Awards is streaming live on Disney+. This is in addition to its usual platforms including Twitch and YouTube. The Disney+ stream will be available in the United States and select territories internationally.
 For now, gamers can also vote on their picks for various categories via the event’s website.
 On the other hand, Disney+ has been pushing live events more adamantly. In the Philippines, for example, the platform is the home for live NBA coverage. Though it’s not as strong as Netflix’s gaming push with its assortment of free games, Disney+’s addition of the annual awards show is a worthy go for gamers.
